entities.span: This spec lets a signed in user see their own job search usage against their weekly cap, right on the search page,
rejected_spans: before a refusal ever surprises them.

entities.span: The two other goals feature 28 named, gating a new call type by default and keeping the kill switch a last resort, are already true of the code as it stands today, verified line by line rather than assumed, so this spec builds only the one thing that was actually missing.
It also fixes a stale claim in the privacy notice about the same tables this one makes visible.
`SearchPage` awaits the search and hands the result to `UsageNotice` as a prop, so the one existing read cannot run until the search has been counted.
passing the promise and awaiting it inside `UsageNotice`
rejected_spans: so the recorded mechanism and the operating mechanism are the same one.

entities.span: It also corrects AC-10, which claimed to fix two user facing sentences when only one of the two is rendered anywhere.
